objects.name: NovaCrest Capital Group
objects.description: Investment management firm, $4.2B AUM. Victim of Case NCA-2026-06.

objects.name: FIN-NC-001
objects.description: Financially motivated ransomware operator targeting financial services. Attributed with 78% confidence to GOLD MYSTIC / LockBit affiliate. Targets financial services firms in $1B-$10B AUM range. Double-extortion model; ransom = 3-5% of target AUM in Monero. Active since at least March 2026.

objects.name: Operation NovaCrest (NCA-2026-06)
objects.description: 11-day intrusion targeting NovaCrest Capital Group June 14-25, 2026. Spearphishing initial access; 5-day dwell; ~293 MB exfil; LockBit 3.0 variant ransomware encrypting 2,215 GB on June 19.

objects.name: ncrypt ransomware
objects.description: LockBit 3.0 builder variant. Compiled 2026-06-15 (custom victim build). .ncrypt extension. AES-256-CBC + RSA-4096. Anti-recovery: VSS deletion, Windows Backup deletion, bcdedit. Windows service persistence + IFEO debugger hijack. Mutex: Global\NovaCryptMutex_NOVA-20260619-7X4K.

objects.name: Sliver C2 implant
objects.description: BishopFox Sliver open-source C2. Deployed on WS-FIN-04 2026-06-14. JA3: a0e9f5d64349fb13191bc781f81f42e1. JARM: 1dd28f00000000000043d43d000000ba86b6e5f1c028a5c19b35dd9e71a15c.

objects.name: FIN-NC-001 C2 IP
objects.description: Primary C2 server. AS209588 (Flyservers S.A., NL). Bulletproof hosting. Active across all attack phases June 14-19. Previously in FS-ISAC advisory April 2026.

objects.name: ncrypt ransomware SHA256
objects.description: LockBit 3.0 variant binary (svchost32.exe). Compiled 2026-06-15. UPX packed. Custom victim build confirmed by mutex.

objects.name: FIN-NC-001 Threat Actor Profile — NovaCrest Capital Group Incident
objects.description: Threat intelligence report on FIN-NC-001 based on forensic analysis of NovaCrest breach (NCA-2026-06). 78% attribution confidence to GOLD MYSTIC/LockBit affiliate. 29 ATT&CK techniques documented. 3 prior victims confirmed. IOC set for FS-ISAC sharing.
